王朴说着，脸上露出一副极其享受的模样，“你是不知道，那味道简直太美妙了，每吸一口，都能让鬼着迷！”

他露出了一副瘾君子的模样，顿了顿，又继续说道：“从那以后，我就一直在国内的恐怖屋之类的地方游荡，有时候，还会假扮成NPC，游客见了我，都以为我是工作人员假扮的，呵呵！”

王朴一脸的得意的笑，仿佛对自己的杰作非常的满意。

“大哥，我跟你说，我知道国内哪里的恐怖屋最好玩、最刺激，我可以介绍你们去玩啊！”

可话音刚落，王朴的情绪又瞬间低落了下来。

“我最对不起的，就是我被吓死的那个鬼屋了。”

“听说，因为我的死，鬼屋的老板被勒令整改了好长的时间，等能重新开业的时候，却因为我的死，让老板有了心理阴影，最后还是将鬼屋关停了！”

吴姜也忍不住同情起那个鬼屋老板，要不是太敬业了，把鬼屋布置得太逼真，也不会闹出这么一档子事。

又过了十几分钟，王朴终于讲完自己的经历。

听完王朴的讲述，吴姜也听明白了，这家伙的心性还停留在高中刚刚毕业的那个阶段，确实是个好鬼，不仅没害过人，他在游荡的这几年里，还暗中救过不少人。

这家伙喜欢到处游荡，着实做了不少的好事。

这次缠着念念，也是因为难得碰到一个和他一样阴气纯净的同类，寂寞之下，才想将念念拐走，陪他作伴。

不仅如此，他还好心教念念怎么吸取人类的七情六欲来提升实力，只是，念念不感兴趣罢了。

吴姜也开始犯难了，身为鬼差，他的职责就是抓滞留阳间的凶魂厉鬼，可王朴这厉鬼，心性纯良得不像话，不仅没作恶，还做了不少好事，他不知道应不应该将他带去地府。

纠结了好一会儿，吴姜还是开口问道：“你想不想跟我去地府报到？只有去了地府，你才有投胎转世、重新做人的机会。”

听到吴姜的话，王朴的脑袋顿时摇的就跟拨浪鼓似的。

“不要，我现在发现，做鬼实在太好玩了，就算偷偷做一些坏事，别人也不会发现。”

说着，王朴的脸上露出了一抹古怪的笑容，吴姜见到，顿时心领神会，毕竟，他也干过类似的事情。

李月芽手上拿着一张阴阳通目符，这会儿她也不怎么害怕了。

不过，看到一人一鬼脸上的笑容，总觉得哪里不对，但却是想不明白。

Wang Pu said, with a look of great enjoyment on his face, "You don't know, the taste is so wonderful, every puff will make ghosts fascinated!"

He showed the look of a drug addict, paused, and continued: "Since then, I have been wandering around in places like horror houses in China. Sometimes, I will also pretend to be an NPC. When tourists see me, they all think I am a staff member pretending to be a staff member, haha!"

Wang Pu had a proud smile on his face, as if he was very satisfied with his masterpiece.

"Brother, let me tell you, I know which horror house in China is the most fun and exciting, and I can introduce you to it!"

But as soon as he finished speaking, Wang Pu's mood suddenly dropped again.

"The thing I'm most sorry for is the haunted house where I was scared to death."

"I heard that because of my death, the owner of the haunted house was ordered to make corrections for a long time. When he was able to reopen, his death caused a psychological shadow on the owner, and he finally closed the haunted house!"

Wu Jiang couldn't help but sympathize with the owner of the haunted house. If he hadn't been so dedicated and decorated the haunted house so realistically, he wouldn't have caused such a trouble.

After another ten minutes, Wang Pu finally finished telling his story.

After listening to Wang Pu's story, Wu Jiang also understood that this guy's character was still at the stage where he had just graduated from high school. He was indeed a good ghost. Not only had he never harmed anyone, he had also secretly saved many people during his wandering years.

This guy likes to wander around and does a lot of good things.

This time I pestered Nian Nian because it was rare to meet a similar person with the same pure yin energy as him. When I was lonely, I wanted to abduct Nian Nian and keep him company.

Not only that, he also kindly taught Nian Nian how to absorb human emotions and desires to improve his strength, but Nian Nian was not interested.

Wu Jiang also started to get into trouble. As a ghost agent, his duty was to catch the evil ghosts stranded in the earth. But Wang Pu, a ghost with a very pure heart, not only did no evil, but also did a lot of good deeds. He didn't know whether he should take him to the underworld.

After struggling for a while, Wu Jiang finally asked: "Do you want to report to the underworld with me? Only when you go to the underworld can you have the opportunity to be reincarnated and start a new life."

After hearing Wu Jiang's words, Wang Pu's head suddenly shook like a rattle.

"No, I've discovered now that being a ghost is really fun. Even if you do some bad things secretly, others won't find out."

As he spoke, Wang Pu showed a strange smile on his face. When Wu Jiang saw it, he immediately understood. After all, he had done similar things before.

Li Yueya held a Yin-Yang eye-opening talisman in her hand, and now she was not so scared.

However, seeing the smiles on the faces of one person and one ghost, I always felt that something was wrong, but I couldn't figure it out.
